messages:
deploy-bot: P0 alert — elevated 5xx and timeouts on /v1/generate (ingress). Paging oncall @sara. Auto-run diagnostics started. :rotating_light:
sara: on it. quick customer impact summary? which regions?
mike: US-east mostly, spike started ~2801234500. 5xx rate ~12% => now seeing request timeouts and gateway 504s. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/ingress?m=/v1/generate
elaine: getting traces now — can someone paste a sample correlation id from a 504/502? need to stitch upstream trace.
mike: sample logs attached (trimmed):
```
2026-03-10T17:02:31Z request_id=ingress-2801234512 correlation_id=i-8a3c req="POST /v1/generate" status=502 upstream=proxy-model-01 attempts=3 latency_ms=1204
2026-03-10T17:02:33Z request_id=ingress-2801234519 correlation_id=i-8a3c req="POST /v1/generate" status=504 upstream=proxy-model-02 attempts=1 latency_ms=5000
2026-03-10T17:02:34Z request_id=ingress-2801234523 correlation_id=i-7f2b req="POST /v1/generate" status=502 upstream=proxy-model-01 attempts=2 latency_ms=900
```
elaine: I see repeated correlation_id prefixes (i-8a3c) across retries — looks like clients are reusing a probe ID? that causes our gateway to retry and fanout to multiple upstreams.
jason: hypothesis: health-check/probe flood from a misconfigured probe client is hammering the model-proxy; model-proxy intermittently 502s -> our default gateway retry policy kicks in -> amplification. also seeing upstream connection resets in same window.
tanya: mitigation idea: temporarily disable gateway retries for /v1/generate path and turn on route-level rate-limit for probes. I'll apply retries=0 for that route and add a 5r/s burst cap for service-account probes.
infra-bot: applying config change: route /v1/generate retries set to 0 by infra-runbook (runbook ticket INF-621). rolling config to edge nodes.
mike: config landed at ~2801234690 — post-change 5xx dropped from 12% -> 2% in 60s. latency p95 improved from 1.4s -> 0.6s.
sara: good. can we assemble a timeline + log bundle for RCA? include upstream model-proxy logs, ingress kvlogs, and the client probe source IPs.
mike: uploaded logs to gs://redwood-incident-archives/2801234567/ (kvlog, proxy logs, traces). sample upstream trace (proxy-model-01):
```
trace_id=tr-2801 span=model-proxy status=502 message="backend queue full" host=10.2.1.12 at=2026-03-10T17:02:30Z
trace_id=tr-2801 span=gateway retry_attempt=1 forwarded_to=proxy-model-02 at=2026-03-10T17:02:32Z status=504
```
elaine: next steps for RCA: 1) correlate client IPs with probe agents (sre -> security), 2) dig into model-proxy queueing metrics + recent deploys, 3) validate whether our retry policy should be route-scoped by idempotency header.
jason: adding hypothesis: sudden spike caused model-proxy backlog due to a stale Nagle setting on connection pool — looking into infra change history.
tanya: I've opened INF-622 to add a canary for retry policy changes and INF-623 to track probe client fixes.
sara: handing off oncall to elaine for follow-up hours (I need to jump to customer call). elaine — please update this thread with RCA doc link once available. :thumbsup:
elaine: will do. initial mitigation worked, customers reporting reduced errors. collecting traces for full causal analysis and will post RCA draft to Confluence /incidents/2801234567-rca when ready.
deploy-bot: Incident resolved -> mitigated (route-level change). Please continue post-incident RCA and tag followups.
